findings.title: Verifier can replace the exact candidate before validating it
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 4 requires D08 to execute “only staged frozen entry/dependency/fixture bytes plus the exact candidate”; criterion 11 requires an honest, verifiable real N70 path.
findings.trigger: A D02-valid frozen verifier writes `<work>/candidate.json` before reading the candidate. The verifier sandbox grants `file-write*` over the entire work root, including that file.
findings.consequence: D08 can return PASS while its receipt binds the original candidate SHA-256 even though the verifier evaluated different bytes, allowing N70 to admit an unverifiable candidate.
findings.evidence: `runtime/langgraph_factory/transport.py:2058` checks candidate bytes only before execution; lines 2113-2123 give `render_sandbox_profile` the whole work directory, whose rule at line 689 grants file writes; fixtures and candidate then execute at lines 2155-2187 without another candidate hash check. Real `sandbox-exec` reproduction `QA/exec/qa_rc19_candidate_mutation_probe.py:19-90` submitted `{"accept":false}` (SHA `0f727f3b...`), rewrote it to `{"accept":true}` (SHA `08372e57...`), and returned `receipt_result: PASS`, `receipt_candidate_sha256: 0f727f3b...`, `receipt_still_claims_original: true`, and `profile_grants_work_root_write: true`.

findings.title: Undeclared engine-path existence changes a frozen replay after rename
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 requires missing declarations to fail pre-entry; criterion 5 forbids undeclared engine metadata visibility; criterion 6 requires undeclared add/remove/rename changes not to alter the same candidate and frozen-contract verdict.
findings.trigger: A D01/D02-valid verifier declares no dependencies, stats a hard-coded undeclared engine path, and distinguishes sandbox `PermissionError` for an existing path from `FileNotFoundError` after that path is renamed.
findings.consequence: The same frozen contract and candidate receive contradictory PASS/FAIL verdicts based solely on an undeclared repository rename; D02 does not reject the missing declaration, and the sandbox exposes path-existence metadata.
findings.evidence: Real D01→D02→D08 reproduction `QA/exec/qa_rc19_full_replay_invariance_probe.py:19-132` reported `d01_guard: inputs_frozen`, `d02_guard: effective_run_compiled`, `compiled_dependencies: []`, and identical candidate/contract SHA-256 values. Before rename it returned PASS with `undeclared-existing: denied`; after renaming only the undeclared file it returned FAIL with `undeclared-absent: visible`. The supplied required probe independently reproduced the same transition at `rc19_required_verifier_probes.py:84-86`: first PASS, then FAIL with `FileNotFoundError` after the undeclared rename.

observations: The artifact SHA and all claimed graph/spec/schema/contract digests recomputed correctly, including graph v8’s required historical hash.
The real plan validator, 75-claim ownership verifier, complete-tree scanner, package suite (176), focused suite (799), and full runtime suite (1352 passed, 2 skipped, 419 subtests) passed.

The required probes confirmed the engine-nested N70 output maps to an external work root, staged layout is preserved, staged conflicts and hash/copy races fail closed, direct file/engine-directory metadata reads are denied, and verifier profiles omit network, model-auth, and model-scratch permissions.

D02 correctly rejected explicitly missing dependency arrays, curriculum escape, duplicates, oversize lists, and declared-byte drift. Plan 26 reported no stale receipts, and a fresh graph-v9 N00 attempt began successfully.
reasoning: All requested probes completed. Passing regressions and direct metadata checks were not promoted to findings. FAIL rests on two independently executed runtime defects: writable candidate bytes make the receipt dishonest, and Seatbelt’s existing-versus-absent error distinction preserves an undeclared path-existence oracle that changes replay verdicts.
